prompt: A student walks 70 m east and then 20 m west along the same straight path. Determine (a) the total distance travelled and (b) the displacement.
hints: For distance, add every part of the path.
For displacement, compare the final position with the start and include direction.
solution: (a) Total distance = 90 m. (b) Displacement = 50 m east.
teacher_walkthrough: Distance follows the complete route, so add 70 m and 20 m to obtain 90 m.
Take east as positive. The displacement is +70 m - 20 m = +50 m.
Translate the positive sign back into the stated direction. The displacement is 50 m east.
